enchantments.tooltip: Absorb Doomsphere Spells: This effect absorbs most spells cast by doomsphere eyestalks. Only a few such spells can be absorbed before the item ceases to function and must have time to dissipate the energy.
Deathblock: The wearer of this item is immune to all death spells and magical death effects.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
